asks: What happens when a computer reaches hundreds of hosts for the first time?
answer: A rule that ships with Silo, switched on, alerts you when a computer reaches a host for the first time. You can narrow it or switch it off. Alerts of one kind in one computer that arrive close together reach you as one alert with a count.

sets.says: A rule that ships with Silo, switched on until you narrow it or switch it off, alerts you when a computer reaches a host for the first time.
